generate_images_from_embeddings: generate images from image embeddings using the WuerstchenDecoderPipeline with a text prompt and guidance scale
encode_text_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method for classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare random or custom latent tensors scaled by the scheduler init noise sigma for image generation
configure_classifier_free_guidance: configure classifier-free guidance by setting a guidance scale greater than 1 and providing a negative prompt
decode_latents_to_images: decode VQ-VAE latents into PIL images or numpy arrays using the vqgan decoder with configurable output type
